phase: Before any new-cohort initial implementation or native rendering
arm_execution: Sequential whole-arm own-delivery episodes within each case; cases sequential. Do not enqueue inactive arm D0. This avoids contaminating isolated per-PR wall with the other arm's native queue. Same default FIFO controller, no code changes for scheduling.
d0_readiness: First durably complete terminal diagnostic bundle; legitimate acquisition/shape/runtime failures remain F/U and still start the clock. No clock reset on retry. Inflight/incomplete/integrity-violated source or immutable inputs cannot unlock.
worker_blinding: Only own assigned public inputs, identical initial source and frozen arm tool; no other-arm evidence/source/claims, no private inputs; no coordinator product repair.
source_lock: Irrevocable at deadline or early seal; readonly final/review/shape admission may finish later, always exact sealed bytes.
timing_scope: Own first D0 enqueue through final self/source/service/resource closure; shared design/initial/rejected-cohort research and later hidden wait separately retained. No overlapping other-arm SDK or CI during an own episode.
control: baseline-v12.6-common-6, shared18path correctness floor not treatmentcredit
treatment: candidate-v13.9 frozen before new designs; no SUT changes
scope_limit: Five related reusable-component tasks, one host/software configuration, warm shared build caches; shared template correlation and small sample forbid broad population claims.
